jobs.college: Drury University-College of Continuing Professional Studies
jobs.description: MyDrury Email Canvas OneLogin Drury Today Adjunct Instructor Openings Custom Search Sort byRelevanceDate The Adjunct Instructor position at Drury University is a contract-based position. Contracts are one semester in duration and do not guarantee future contract offerings. This position requires an individual who is dedicated to delivering high-quality instruction in the specified discipline. In addition to teaching duties, the individual must comply with requests from various University offices (i.e., Registrar, Advising, Drury GO Administrative Staff, and Office of Academic Affairs). Harrisonville Campus Communication Instructor (Adjunct / Per Course) Requirements: A master’s degree or PhD in Communication or a master’s degree in another field with at least 18 graduate credit hours in Communication is required. View the full job description. To apply, complete the online application. General Studies Instructor (Adjunct / Per Course) Requirements: A master’s degree or PhD is required, preferably in Business, IT, or Accounting. Related work experience is a plus. Course assignments may be seated or blended. View the full General Studies job description. To apply, complete the online application. Legal Studies Instructor (Adjunct / Per Course) Requirements: A Juris Doctorate is preferred, but a master’s degree in Legal Studies or a master’s degree in another field with at least 18 graduate credit hours in Legal Studies is required. View the full job description. To apply, complete the online application. Organizational Leadership Studies Instructor (Adjunct / Per Course) Requirements: A master’s degree or PhD is required, preferably in Business, Organizational Leadership, or Education. Related work experience is a plus. Course assignments may be seated or blended. View the full job description. To apply, complete the online application. Mid-MO Campuses Biology Instructor (Adjunct / Per Course) Requirements: A master’s degree or PhD in Biology, or a master’s degree in another field with at least 18 graduate credit hours in Biology, is required — immediate need for a Molecular Biology course. View the full Biology job description. To apply, complete the online application. Chemistry Instructor (Adjunct / Per Course) Requirements: A master’s degree or PhD in Chemistry, or a master’s degree in another field with at least 18 graduate credit hours in Chemistry, is required. To apply, complete the online application. Sociology Instructor (Adjunct / Per Course) Requirements: A master’s degree or PhD in Sociology is required (MSW will not suffice). Course assignments may include seated or blended courses. View the full job description. To apply, complete the online application. Psychology Instructor (Adjunct / Per Course) Requirements: A master’s degree or a PhD in Psychology is required. Course assignments may include seated or blended courses. View the full job description. To apply, complete the online application. Monett Campus Sociology Instructor (Adjunct / Per Course) Requirements: A master’s degree or PhD in Sociology is required (MSW will not suffice). Course assignments may include seated or blended courses. View the full job description. To apply, complete the online application.
